faqs.question: What is YouAndINotAI?
faqs.answer: YouAndINotAI is a verified-human dating platform launched April 4, 2026. Every person on the platform passes a liveness check to prove they're human. No bots, fake profiles, or catfish allowed. We charge $1 for verification and $14.99/month for founding members (price locked forever).

faqs.question: How does the verification process work?
faqs.answer: When you join YouAndINotAI, you complete a liveness check challenge—our Bot-Shield system. You pay $1 to verify, complete a quick video check, and you're verified as human. This single friction point keeps out bots while letting real people through.

faqs.question: What are founding member spots?
faqs.answer: Founding member spots are limited to 100 people. If you join before April 4, 2026, you lock in $14.99/month forever—no matter what the price becomes after launch. This is a one-time rate lock for early supporters.

faqs.question: How much does it cost?
faqs.answer: $1 to verify your identity via Bot-Shield. Then $14.99/month for founding members (locked forever), or standard pricing after April 4 launch. Founding spots are limited to 100.

faqs.question: Is my data safe?
faqs.answer: Yes. All users are verified through liveness checks, so you know you're talking to real people. Your identity is verified but private. We don't share your data with bots or third parties.

faqs.question: Can I get a refund?
faqs.answer: The $1 verification fee is non-refundable—it's a one-time identity check. If you have billing issues with your subscription, contact support@youandinotai.com.

faqs.question: How do I contact support?
faqs.answer: Email support@youandinotai.com for technical issues, billing questions, or account help. We typically respond within 24 hours.

faqs.question: What makes YouAndINotAI different from other dating apps?
faqs.answer: We treat being human as a requirement, not a suggestion. Every person you match with has been verified as human via liveness check. No fake profiles, no bots—just real people looking for real connections.

faqs.question: When does YouAndINotAI launch?
faqs.answer: Public launch is April 4, 2026. Founding members get early access and lock in $14.99/month forever. Only 100 founding spots available.

faqs.question: How do I become a founding member?
faqs.answer: Visit youandinotai.com, complete verification ($1), and subscribe to the founding member plan ($14.99/month). Your rate is locked forever. Only 100 spots, so sign up soon!

faqs.question: Is there a mobile app?
faqs.answer: Not yet—we're launching web-first on April 4, 2026. Mobile apps may come later based on user demand. Check youandinotai.com for updates.

faqs.question: What if I get catfished or matched with a fake profile?
faqs.answer: That shouldn't happen on YouAndINotAI because every person passes a liveness check. If you suspect a profile is fake, report it immediately at support@youandinotai.com and we'll investigate.
